subject: Order of treatments on X axis for error bar

messages.author: 81de21f613ba8a94
messages.subject: Order of treatments on X axis for error bar
parts:
Hello,
I was wondering how I can define in which order my treatments appear on the X axis. I would like that treatment "C" is listed first (on the very left site of the axis) flowed by the other treatments (2d_1cat etc.). Right now  treatment "C" is on the last position (on the very right site, see attachment). I tried to do the following since I know that this is working if I would want to create a barplot:

data$Leaf <- factor(data$Leaf, levels = c("C","2d_1cat","2d_3cat","2d_9cat","7d_1cat"))

But in the case of errorbars it seems not to work. Has anyone an idea?


My code:

data$Leaf <- factor(data$Leaf, levels = c("C","2d_1cat","2d_3cat","2d_9cat","7d_1cat"))
#setlevels of the factor in the required order.

#---------------------------------------------
#plotting in ggplot
# To prevent that errorbars overlap use position_dodge to move them horizontally
pd <- position_dodge(0.4) # move them .05 to the left and right
#Create errorbar using 95% CI, color =damage
ggplot(CI, aes(x=Leaf, y=Av_Glands_cor, colour=Lable)) +
  #widht= wisker widht, siz=widht of bars
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=Av_Glands_cor-ci, ymax=Av_Glands_cor+ci), width=.4, size=1.2,position=pd) +
  #bars should be next to each other (not stacked)
  geom_line(position=pd) +
  #Color for errorbars 
  scale_colour_manual(values=c("gray80", "gray65", "gray40", "black", "white"))+
  #size of points indicateing mean 
  geom_point(position=pd,size=4.4)+
  #Labeling of axes and size of lables and legend
  labs(x="Leaf",y="Average nr. glands corrected for leaf sz.")+
  theme(axis.text=element_text(size=13),
        axis.title=element_text(size=16,face="bold"))+
  theme(legend.text=element_text(size=14),legend.title=element_text(size=14))



Thanks a lot,
Michael
